## 主张 Claim

对持 S0（自身的生及继续生成对自己有提供理由的正面意义）的评价位置：其一，S0 加上不受限（跨越自他）的单调性（等价于随附性、剖面单调估值与 BI），使任何至少同样相连于某一被珍视的自身继续生成的他者生命具有正面意义；承认“连接程度就是完整根据”的只承认“我的”的对手，一旦自身继续生成分化出这样的他者，就严格不一致。其二，再加容差与分级连通，正面意义及于此位置活动所能及的全部生命与继续生成；所得是 G0 谓词在此立场、单一历史、可及库存上的实例。超出 S0 的全部内容由容差承担；所采用的不带索引、跨接续的 G0，仍需从立场相对意义到规范意义的桥接。 / For an evaluating position holding S0 (its own living and further generation have reason-giving positive significance): first, S0 with unrestricted monotonicity across self and other (equivalently supervenience, a profile-monotone valuation and BI) gives positive significance to any living occurrence at least as connected as a valued occurrence of its own further generation, and an own-only rival that grants connection degree as the whole ground is inconsistent once its further generation differentiates into such an occurrence; second, adding tolerance and graded connection, significance reaches all living generation the position's activity can condition, a standpoint-indexed, single-history instance of the G0 predicate on the reachable inventory. Tolerance carries everything beyond S0; the adopted unindexed G0 over continuations still needs a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance.

Canonical source: [EvaluatorGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/EvaluatorGrounding.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- S0 与容差都是实质规范前提；S0 第一人称。“继续生成”包括自身的学习与转化；由此活动形成的他者不在 S0 的内容之内。 / S0 and tolerance are both substantive normative premises; S0 is first-personal. Further generation includes the evaluator's own learning and transformation; others formed by its activity are not part of S0's content.
- 不受限单调性与随附性是规范的结构前提，并非由“无原始所有者”蕴涵；不受限单调性等价于随附性、剖面单调估值与 BI（自我之善的根据剖面不含自身区域坐标），BI 有争议。对手自己的近远原则只限自身发生。 / Unrestricted monotonicity and supervenience are normative structural premises, not entailed by “no primitive owner”; unrestricted monotonicity amounts to supervenience, a profile-monotone valuation and BI (the grounding profile has no own-region coordinate), and BI is contested. A rival's own near-over-far principle ranges over own occurrences only.
- 第二步另用容差与分级连通；容差只约束正与无之间的跳变，不约束权重。二值全称容差在连通剖面上等价于正面意义为常值，也可把“无”向回传递。 / Step two adds tolerance and graded connection; tolerance constrains only the positive-to-none flip, not weights. Two-valued universal tolerance on a connected profile space makes positive significance constant and carries “none” backward as readily.
- 不使用 G0、D 或 J1–J4 作为前提；“提供理由”是 S0 的内容，Lean 只传递该谓词。 / G0, D and J1–J4 are not premises; reason-giving is the content of S0, and Lean only transports the predicate.

分化（Diff）是对应前提，适用于分裂、复制、分叉与 AI 后继者，以及以形成性贡献为主导的评价方式；在 profile2 的积序下对任何立场都不成立，加权和序下须形成性贡献权重至少为组织连续性的 7/5。Chain 取在可能剖面上，因此容差也是对仅仅可能的剖面如何估值的主张。有限模型中的程度数字只表示顺序；实际对应须在应用中取得证据。 / Differentiation (Diff) is a correspondence premise in scope for fission, copying, forking and AI successors and for formative-contribution-led evaluation; in profile2 it fails for every standpoint under the product order, and under a weighted sum it needs formative contribution weighted at least 7/5 of organizational continuity. Chain ranges over possible profiles, so tolerance is also a claim about valuing merely possible profiles. Degree numbers are orderings only; actual correspondence needs evidence in each application.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 成功实查12项新定理／29项声明审计：19项空依赖、8项 propext、2项 propext 与 Quot.sound；无 Classical.choice 或自定义公理；一般定理均为空依赖。3项应用例不计入。独立审查已完成（EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md）：推论与复核接受，第一步收窄，容差的辩护不被接受；15 项更正已执行，Lean 说明更正后重跑检查器。 / Successful Lean 4.29.1 check: 12 new theorems/29 declaration audits, comprising 19 empty, 8 propext and 2 propext with Quot.sound dependencies; no Classical.choice or custom axiom; the general theorems have empty dependencies. 3 application examples are not counted. Independent review completed (EVALUATOR-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md): inferences and recheck accepted, step one narrowed, tolerance's defence not accepted; its 15 corrections are applied, and the checker was rerun after the Lean documentation was corrected.

所得是正面意义，不是权重、许可、义务或排序，也不预测认识或遵循。普遍性限于持 S0 并接受不受限单调性（含 BI）与容差的评价者；S0 本身不能对每一可能评价者推出；容差对闭合坐标对手与归零权重对手没有得到辩护。内容范围限于 S0 所及的那类生命，不推出一切组织形成的正面意义，也不处理使新生命存在的价值。 / Yields positive significance, not weight, permission, duty or ranking, and predicts no recognition or compliance. Universality is limited to evaluators holding S0 and accepting unrestricted monotonicity (with BI) and tolerance; S0 cannot be derived for every possible evaluator; tolerance is not defended against the closure-coordinate and zero-reaching-weight rivals. Content scope is the kind of living S0 attaches to; positive significance of all organization formation and the value of bringing new lives into existence are not derived.

- 无 S0 的现时目的评价者满足单调性、随附性与容差，却不给任何东西以意义；结论对一切可能评价者不成立。 / A present-aim evaluator without S0 satisfies monotonicity, supervenience and tolerance yet assigns no significance; the conclusion does not hold for every possible evaluator. Parfitian continuity and autopoietic closure are isomorphic monist formations.
